page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a title block at the top (two heads) followed by numbered annotation paragraphs running down the page. No margin notes. Page number at the head.

main_text.head: GVILIELMI XYLANDRI AVGVST. Annotatiunculæ.
IN METAMORPHOSES Antonini Liberalis.
main_text.p: 1 In Cragaleo sedasse.) ποιῆσαι πλασσάνις[?], legō ϖαῦσαι.
2 VI. Sacriq; custos fulminis.) τὸ ἱερὸν σιδηροῦν[?]. legi, τὸν ἱερὸν σιδηροῦν.
3 VII. Quòd ipsum destituisset.) Ad verbum ἐχῶ[?] refertur etymon. cuius varia significata apud Grammaticos est inuenire. Ego αὐτὸν legi: & λαμῶνα, pro χαμῶνα[?] reposui.
Hoc modo.) ἅτω[?] legi, cum reperirem ἅπω[?].
Pellus Erodij genus est. De ephippo dubito: & fortasse est legendum ἵππῳ, equo.

4 X. Κελεύντων[?]. ) Ego quid vocis hoc sit, non inuenio. itaq; asteriscum loco versionis posui. Caeterum multa passim perspicuè depravata, ex ingenio ac sensu correxi: quæ omnia annotare non erat operæ pretium.
5 XII. In Cygno vini vi est obrutus.) Ἐχαρακώθη[?]. lego ἐκαρώθη[?]. Post vbi asteriscum signaui, tenor fabulæ ex VII Ouidij Metamorph. potest intelligi: ad quod opus illustrandum, hic li-ber

page.notes: Greek words are read with uncertainty throughout (breathings, accents and some letters are hard to make out at this scan resolution) and are marked [?]. Words with a mark were read letter by letter but may be off. The paragraph at the foot continues onto the next page ("ber" completes the broken word "liber"). The title block sits above the annotations. The page number is printed at the head.
